column1: # Noun + particle + verb collocations for Issue #335. Several verbs share one
# reading (閉める / 占める, 降る / 振る, 着く / 付く, 空く / 開く), and no
# per-word price can choose between them, because the right spelling depends on
# the noun two words earlier (窓を閉める, 雨が降る, 駅に着く). Each row here
# expands into one compound dictionary edge per verb form; the edges and
# their prices live in verb-collocation-edges.tsv, regenerated with
# Columns: the noun's reading and surface, the particle (reading and surface
# are the same kana; empty when the verb follows the noun directly, as in
# ずっと待つ), then the verb's dictionary-form reading and surface. Every
# noun and verb must be an existing dictionary entry; the generator stops on
# one that is not. A pair only helps the exact collocation listed: the table
